title: TEMP_NEO_Senior Salesforce Administrator
description:
Job Title: Senior Salesforce Administrator
Location: Remote, US hours EST preferred
Contract: 6 months

Job Summary:
We are seeking a talented Sr. Salesforce Administrator to help support our Go-to-Market systems team. This role is focused on providing foundational, day-to-day support for our sales and operations teams. The ideal candidate will serve as the first line of defense for end user support, focused on resolving access issues, troubleshooting standard platform errors, and performing minor configurations to keep our Salesforce environment running smoothly.

Key Responsibilities:
- Tier 1 Support & Triage: Act as the primary point of contact for basic end-user support tickets.
- User & Access Management: Handle routine user provisioning, de-provisioning and access changes. Manage roles, profiles, permission sets, and sharing rules.
- System Troubleshooting: Investigate and resolve basic issues related to access, visibility, and error messages.
- Minor Configuration: Perform routine administrative tasks such as updating fields, page layouts, list views, reports.
- Data Maintenance: Assist with basic data hygiene tasks, including data updates, imports/exports.
- Process Monitoring: Monitor existing basic automations (Flows, Validation Rules) and report issues.
- Documentation: Maintain clear documentation on system processes and SOPs.

Required Qualifications:
- 5-7 years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator
- Strong communication skills
- Salesforce Certified Administrator (ADM 201) highly preferred
- Solid understanding of Salesforce standard objects (Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Opportunities)
- Foundational security model knowledge (profiles, permission sets, sharing rules)
- Experience in ad-tech, social media, or consumer tech GTM environments preferred
- US-based, in-house admin experience preferred (NOT consulting firms)
- Target companies: Snap, Pinterest, Twitter/X, TikTok, LinkedIn, Meta, Trade Desk, Spotify, HubSpot, Zendesk, Atlassian, Twilio, Braze, Outbrain, Taboola, Salesforce

Additional requirements: 5+ years experience required

--- KEY SIGNALS (AI-extracted) ---
• Required certifications: Salesforce Certified Administrator (ADM 201)
• Must-have tools/jargon: Salesforce Flows, Salesforce Sharing Rules, Salesforce Permission Sets, Salesforce Standard Objects (Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Opportunities)
• Domain: ad-tech/SaaS Go-to-Market systems administration
• Emphasized traits: Strong communication, Attention to detail, Problem-solving, Documentation discipline

title: Operator I_MN ONLY - 2nd Shift
description:
Job Title: Operator I

Location : Minnetonka, MN
Job Type : 12 Months of Contract + possible extension
Schedule : 3:30 PM to 2:00 AM & 4:00 - 2:30 AM

Job Description

The Operator I is responsible for performing routine and repetitive assembly operations within a medical device manufacturing environment under direct supervision. The role focuses on producing high-quality medical devices while following standardized manufacturing procedures, maintaining accurate documentation, and supporting quality, safety, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

· Perform routine assembly operations following standardized work instructions and procedures.

· Ensure job documentation for manufacturing cell operations is accurate and up to date.

· Maintain accurate production, traveler, and quality records to ensure product traceability.

· Troubleshoot basic production issues and communicate solutions effectively.

· Clearly communicate ideas, problems, and solutions to manufacturing management both verbally and in writing.

· Demonstrate strong teamwork through active participation, cooperation, flexibility, and effective communication.

· Maintain a positive attitude while interacting with internal teams and visitors during facility tours.

· Follow all safety guidelines and use appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) during operations.

· Perform routine preventative maintenance on applicable equipment to maximize efficiency and minimize downtime.

· Participate in Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance quality and productivity.

· Work with Manufacturing Supervisors and Managers to achieve individual goals and manufacturing performance metrics.

· Support divisional initiatives related to Quality Management Systems (QMS), Environmental Management Systems (EMS), and other regulatory requirements.

Required Skills and Qualifications

· Ability to read, comprehend, and follow written procedures and verbal instructions.

· Minimum 7th-grade reading and comprehension level required.

· Basic understanding of electronic data collection systems and computer software.

· Ability to prioritize work and manage tasks efficiently.

· Ability to handle and assemble small components and parts with precision.

· Ability to make sound decisions with minimal supervision.

· Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

· Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented manufacturing environment.

Preferred Qualifications

· 6+ months of experience in a medical device, manufacturing, assembly, or other regulated production environment preferred.

· Previous medical device manufacturing or assembly experience is a plus.

· High School Diploma or GED preferred.

· Bachelor's degree candidates will be considered overqualified for this position.

We are seeking a Sr. Manufacturing Technician to support a new product launch by working closely with the Operations and Engineering teams. title: Sr. Sourcing Manager – 3PM Procurement
description:
Job Title: Sr. Sourcing Manager - 3PM Procurement
Job Location: Remote
Job Duration; 1 Month on W2

Job Description:
Overview:
  • As part of the North American 3PM (3rd Party Manufacturing) Procurement team, the primary purpose of this position is to strategically manage our Contract Manufacturing supply base for the Dairy Yogurt, Protein Shakes and Kids Nutrition Category to help fuel business growth, cost improvement & supplier performance.
  • This mandate can be accomplished through new supplier scouting, leveraging current supplier base, implementing sourcing strategies, supplier and contract management, project management, supplier evaluation, and budget & productivity management.
  • This position requires proven sourcing experience & related skills as well as effective cross functional project leadership, negotiation, collaborative, analytical and communication skills. Experience in Contract Manufacturing and/or Direct Material sourcing will be a strong asset.

Responsibilities:
Sourcing Strategies & Market Analysis:
  • Sourcing strategies development through market studies to identify best practices, identify gaps, risks and opportunities as well as to identify new suppliers and develop a supplier base
  • Conduct supply market analysis and drivers for spend categories to track market, evaluate cost proposals, and ensure 3PM business is aligned with market;
  • Support growth through identification and implementation of continuous improvement plans with existing suppliers
  • Participate in Make vs Buy process for new initiatives to support sourcing decisions
  • Execute strategic sourcing best practices that support the Category Strategic Plan
  • Work collaboratively with colleagues in terms of pricing, quality and supply chain aspects.

Supplier and Contract Management Implement Supplier:
  • Relationship Management to improve supplier’s performance, quality, collaboration, innovation and cost
  • Support initiatives to find available innovation/production capacity/capabilities
  • Develop and launch RFQs / RFPs (request for quotation/proposal) to select suppliers in targeted categories
  • Analyze the proposals and make recommendations to key internal stake holders
  • Negotiate quality, time and cost of service as well as other commercial terms and conditions
  • Lead contract ratification activities, assuring interaction with supplier and Legal teams

Project Management:
  • Collaborate with R&I & Marketing innovation teams by providing key insight on current capabilities, manufacturing site potential, and economic feasibility.
  • Assisted by the project management team, participate in projects implementation by respecting the budgets / schedules / standards quality of ***, using the appropriate tools.
  • Continuously monitor, review and communicate the project status (with respect to contractual commitments of the supplier).
  • Anticipate and alert key stakeholders in case of non-compliance with the contractual commitments.
  • Assure that proper cross-functional project management process between Category teams and the co-manufacturer is in place and followed.
  • Assisted by 3PM Operations team, implement industrial performance metrics with the co-manufacturer plants and monitor/support continuous improvement.
  • Support commercialization of new platforms and capabilities from concept to launch including conducting operations feasibility, and project management follow ups.

Supplier Evaluation:
  • Set up standard KPIs for Suppliers within assignment
  • Evaluate and manage the global performance of Contract Manufacturing suppliers
  • Define the objectives of improvement of performance and the necessary action plans
  • Manage the implementation of action plans.

Budget & Productivity Management:
  • Manage overall spend for Contract Manufacturing sourcing;
  • Establish the budget, track variances and manage risks for respective area through work with Finance and Contract Manufacturing stakeholders
  • Identify new projects to create savings opportunities, validate with finance, seek and attain buy-in for these projects, build budget with other functions, realize and track savings

Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations Management, Supply Chain, or a related field
  • Minimum of 3-6 years experience in Strategic procurement, Contract Manufacturing, Operations Management or similar role
  • Experience in the food-processing industry, especially perishable products is an asset
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional, multi-cultural, matrix environment
  • People management: the individual must demonstrate future capability as well as demonstrated cross-functional / peer to peer leadership through coaching and stewardship
  • Proactive: anticipates issues/opportunities & can work through multiple simultaneous projects
  • Rigorous data analysis capability and financial acumen
  • Ability to develop and implement sustainable initiatives, and lead change by engaging people

Language:
  • English mandatory; French an asset

Job Description:
Continuous improvement, employee must evaluate/monitor/escalate a roadblock identified while working in a role that can cause a defect downstream. Contingent worker must be able to support a root cause analysis and provide details with problem solving skills.
Proper use of equipment to support role, employee must possess fundamental knowledge and skills in operating heavy equipment, primarily PIT equipment/forklifts. This includes understanding the operational mechanics, safety procedures, and maintenance practices associated with such machinery. Employee must be able to operate any equipment needed to move heavy parts/material throughout the facilities within the sites, including but not limited to: electronic pallet jacks (EPJs), forklifts, reach-trucks and turret-trucks.
Receive shipments, employee must be able to unload shipments delivered by carriers.
Inspecting shipments, employee must be able to visually examine packages arriving at the Fulfillment Center and determine if it is acceptable according to a standard operating procedure.
Quality control checks, employee must review requirements for each part number and process accordingly to the standard operating procedure.
Documenting receipts, employee must be able to use tools and equipment to systematically upload, store, and follow standard operating procedures to completely close out a receipt or work order.
Data entry, employee must be able to navigate and select fields within an inventory management tool to input data directly coming from the physical delivery of a part. Employee must be able to navigate through modules and read information as it is needed for a specific task of Fulfillment.
Packaging, employee must be able to identify what type of packaging is needed for parts, must be able to properly wrap/store parts with packaging at any stage of the Fulfillment/Manufacturing workflow.
Sorting and staging, employee must be able to move packages/boxes/crates/any storage container while its identified and secure to prevent loss within the workflow.
Labeling and marking, employee must ensure all parts are part labeled, have identifiers outlined in the standard operating procedure in order to analyze parts through the workflow.
Storage assignment/auditing, employees must properly store and use good judgement along with the standard operating procedure for the storage of parts that could be individual or in bulk. Employee must be able to audit per a standard operating procedure.

Qualifications
2+ years of Fulfillment Center Operations experience, including an industry with receiving and inventory functions.
Safety is a top priority it is imperative that the employee strictly adheres to established safety protocols and guidelines. This includes but is not limited to, wearing appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE), following safe operating procedures, and participating in regular safety training sessions.
Employee must be able to lift 50 lbs.
An attitude of world-class quality, attention to detail, and dedication.
Communication skills within a highly technical environment.
Mathematical skills Analytical skills to define problems, collect appropriate and relevant data, establish facts, and draw reasonable conclusions from gathered information.
Ability to derive inventory requirements from Bills of Material.
Ability to earn trust, maintain positive and professional relationships, and contribute to a culture of inclusion.
Previous certified forklift experience
Desired
Warehouse/Receiving/Inventory experience in the aerospace or automotive industry.
